player_prompt.intro:
Tirite Blackjack mgal uɣellaḥ.
Lmeɛna-k n weɛma-s ad tesɛuḍeɛ ɣer 21 ma nniḍen ur tesɛuḍeɛ ara.
Di lweqt-k, xtar '[Hit]' akken ad tesɛuḍeɛ takarḍa nniḍen neɣ '[Stand]' akken ad tesɛuḍeɛ.
J/Q/K = 10 n yipoint; A = 11 neɣ 1, ma d-yegguni.
